note: Rots et al. (2023, PMC10257005) characterized the clinical spectrum of KDM6B variants in a large cohort (N=85), making evaluation of Kabuki syndrome-distinguishing features plausible.

evidence.text: Rots et al. (2023) evaluated main clinical features across individuals with KDM6B variants, separating protein truncating variants (N = 73) and protein altering variants (N = 12).
